meta.description: Serve up high-energy matches in Mario Tennis Fever, a Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive. Fast-paced tennis with colorful courts and multiplayer fun.

modules.heading: Hit the court for explosive action in the latest Mario Tennis game!

content.value: Join Mario and friends for some Mushroom Kingdom style-tennis! Use topspins, slices, lobs, and other familiar shots—along with other fancy footwork and new defensive maneuvers—to outpace your opponents on the court. Keep a rally going, build up your Fever Gauge, and unleash powerful Fever Shots that can be augmented with special effects by equipping Fever Rackets.

Join Mario and friends for some Mushroom Kingdom style-tennis! Use topspins, slices, lobs, and other familiar shots—along with other fancy footwork and new defensive maneuvers—to outpace your opponents on the court. Keep a rally going, build up your Fever Gauge, and unleash powerful Fever Shots that can be augmented with special effects by equipping Fever Rackets.

Product:{\"sku\":\"7100105869\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Join Mario and friends for over-the-top tennis mayhem! Use topspins, slices, lobs, and other familiar shots—along with other fancy footwork and defensive maneuvers—to outpace your opponents on the court. Keep a rally going, build up your Fever Gauge, and unleash powerful Fever Shots that can be augmented with special effects by equipping Fever Rackets!

Freeze the court with the Ice Racket, summon mushrooms that shrink opponents with the Mini Mushroom Racket, duplicate yourself with the Shadow Racket, and more. Mix and match over 30 different Fever Rackets with 38 playable characters to find a strategy that works for you.

Serve up casual or competitive play in a variety of game modes

Get play-by-play commentary from a Talking Flower in Tournament mode, test your skills and complete various objectives in Trial Towers mode, or take on matches with unexpected rules—and even some Wonder Effects—in Mix it Up mode. Gently swing your Joy-Con™ 2 controller like a racket for a more authentic experience in Swing Mode, hop online* for casual bouts with customizable rules with an Online Room, or go for glory in competitive Ranked Matches. You can even play together with friends who don’t have the game over local wireless via GameShare**!

Experience a story in which Mario and friends, encountering monsters on a remote island, find themselves transformed into babies! Help them relearn their tennis skills and defeat the monsters to return to normal in Adventure mode.

Play on the Galaxy Court, use the Black Hole Racket, and more in a free update

Download a free update*** to access the Galaxy Court, where tennis balls will bounce higher, and unlock the Black Hole Racket, which creates black holes and pulls in anyone who gets too close!

The update also includes new color options for Luma, a Special Match mode where Prankster Comets will trigger various effects, and support for online GameShare via GameChat**, so you can share the tennis fun with friends near and far—even if they don’t have the game!
